obligations_to_time.requirement: The decode target must be able to request gamma corrected RGBA8 output for an accepted PNG with a gAMA chunk.
obligations_to_time.target_route: Supply a valid 1×1 truecolor PNG with a gAMA chunk before IDAT, then decode as RGBA8 with SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA.
obligations_to_time.failure_condition: The entry always passes SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS (1); the gamma guard requires SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA (2), so no input can select gamma correction.

obligations_to_time.requirement: The decode target must be able to request gamma corrected RGBA16 output for an accepted PNG with a gAMA chunk.
obligations_to_time.target_route: Supply a valid 1×1 truecolor PNG with a gAMA chunk before IDAT, size the output for RGBA16, then decode as RGBA16 with SPNG_DECODE_USE_GAMA.
obligations_to_time.failure_condition: The entry always sizes and decodes as SPNG_FMT_RGBA8 (1) with only the transparency flag (1); RGBA16 is format 2 and gamma is flag 2.
